reason: A critical runtime error remains (missing compliance_propensity) and several spec-critical features are still absent (mask types with inward/outward efficacy, location-aware contacts/policies, enforcement actions/costs, and key metrics). With one iteration left, a focused pass can both restore runtime stability and implement the minimal feature set required by the specification and verification.

specific_areas: Fix runtime by adding compliance_propensity to Person and ensuring constructor consistency across modules.
Implement mask types end-to-end: Person.mask_type; Retailer per-type inventory/prices; RetailMarket per-type purchasing; DiseaseDynamics using inward/outward efficacy by type.
Generate contacts per location and tag contacts with location_id; apply location risk multipliers and mandate coverage by location.
Use mandate_start_day and mandate_coverage in PolicyModule; record mandate_active_daily flags.
Track enforcement actions and penalties in PolicyEnforcementModule; accumulate costs_total (penalties + optional campaign/enforcement costs).

Compute missing metrics: enforcement_actions_count, costs_total, adoption_disparity_index (e.g., across political groups or income tertiles), and compliance_rate_under_mandate based on mandate-active days.
Refactor counterfactual incidence to reuse the same uniform random variates or compute deterministically for unbiased infection_rate_reduction.
Harden get_calibrator by filtering kwargs against constructor signature to avoid unexpected-argument errors.

task_understanding.adjustments: Re-anchor implementation to the original spec: multiple mask types with inward/outward efficacy, location-specific policies/contacts, explicit enforcement and costs, and required metrics.

model_planning.adjustments: Plan a minimal viable integration: (1) restore Person field; (2) introduce mask types with a compact mapping and default params; (3) location-tagged contacts using simple per-location multipliers; (4) enforcement/cost accounting; (5) metric computations. Timebox scope to ensure delivery within one iteration.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement changes with small, testable diffs: add fields to dataclasses; adapt modules incrementally; keep interfaces stable. Use the provided code snippet structure to minimize churn and ensure end-to-end wiring.

code_verification.adjustments: Add pre-run assertions: instantiate a Person to catch constructor errors; quick unit for get_calibrator with extra keys; smoke-test a 5-day run with N=100 to ensure no runtime exceptions.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run a short deterministic seed simulation to validate new logic: check that per-location contacts are produced, mandates toggle by day, enforcement actions > 0 when mandates active, and per-type inventories/prices evolve.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute and validate new metrics: enforcement_actions_count > 0 under mandate; costs_total > 0 when penalties or campaign/enforcement costs are set; adoption_disparity_index within [0,1]; compliance_rate_under_mandate computed only on mandate days.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Report a concise changelog tied to verification issues; include acceptance criteria checklist confirming each missing feature/metric is implemented and exercised in the smoke test.
